how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form from the official website, www.gadvasu.in
Fill in all personal, educational and other required details correctly, including mobile number and email ID
Pay the application fee online once the payment link is active (from 16.09.2026) and download the payment receipt
Attach self-attested copies of all qualification, experience and (where applicable) Physically Handicapped certificates, along with the fee receipt
Attach a self-addressed envelope (9"x4") with the application
Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application form with the requisite fee for each post
Ensure the complete application is page-numbered, properly tagged and indexed
Send the completed application so that it reaches the University by the last date, 08.10.2026, up to 4:00 p.m.
In-service candidates must apply through proper channel; the advance copy must reach by 08.10.2026, and the proper-channel copy must reach the Registrar's office by 21.10.2026, up to 4:00 p.m.
The notification does not provide a direct online application portal link; the application form must be downloaded and submitted physically, while only the fee payment is processed online.

faq.question: Q1. What is GADVASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. 04/2026 issued by Guru Angad Dev Veterinary and Animal Sciences University, Ludhiana, inviting applications for 8 posts including Registrar, Director of Research, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and Scientist.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GADVASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies in total, one post each for Registrar, Director of Research, Assistant Professor (Aquatic Environment Management), Scientist (Dairy Technology), Associate Professor (Veterinary Surgery & Radiology), Associate Professor (Veterinary Gynaecology & Obstetrics), Associate Professor (Veterinary Medicine) and Assistant Professor (Veterinary Medicine).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GADVASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the complete application is 08.10.2026, up to 4:00 p.m. In-service candidates applying through proper channel have until 21.10.2026 for that copy to reach the University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GADVASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post, ranging from a Ph.D. with years of teaching/research experience for Registrar and Director of Research, to specific Master's/Bachelor's degrees with minimum OCPA or percentage requirements for Associate Professor, Assistant Professor and Scientist posts. See the post-wise eligibility section above for details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GADVASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification specifies a general minimum age of entry of 18 years and retirement age of 60 years for the University; a separate post-wise upper age limit is not specified.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for GADVASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 2,360/- for Registrar, Director of Research and the three Associate Professor posts, and Rs. 1,770/- for Assistant Professor (Aquatic Environment Management), Scientist (Dairy Technology) and Assistant Professor (Veterinary Medicine). A 50% fee exemption applies to PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for GADVASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the prescribed application form from www.gadvasu.in, fill it, pay the fee online, attach the required documents and self-addressed envelope, and send the complete application by post so it reaches the University before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GADVASU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit score card considering qualifications, higher qualifications and experience. The top 10 candidates per post are called for interview (with a presentation additionally required for Assistant Professor-level posts), and candidates must score at least 50% in the interview to be eligible for selection.
